literal_meaning: অবিরাম পতনের ধ্বনির অনুকরণ (onomatopoeic sound of continuous falling)
example_sentences_in_bangla: চোখ থেকে ঝরঝর করে অশ্রু পড়তে লাগল।
example_sentences_in_english: Tears started falling jhorjhor from her eyes.
history: Referenced in Rabindranath Tagore's literature as 'ঝরঝর বরিষে বারিধারা', evoking the natural rhythm of monsoon rains in Bengali poetry.
note: Primarily used to describe the sound and flow of rain, deeply embedded in Bengali literary expressions of nature.
